newsitem.title: USA: Hughes unit pacts to build Japan Satellite.
newsitem.headline: Hughes unit pacts to build Japan Satellite.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp's Hughes Information Technology Systems, said on Monday that the Japanese Civil Aviation Bureau, or JCAB, has awarded a $37 million contract to Hughes and two other firms to develop a satellite-based navigation system.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The contract was awarded to Hughes, Lockheed Martin Corp's Lockheed Federal Systems and Innovative Solutions International.
JCAB selected the group to build its Multi-Function Transport Satellite Satellite-based Augmentation System.
The satellite system is expected to improve flight safety and increase efficiency for air carriers and navigation-service providers, Hughes said.
